summary: Trapezoidal lead screw, axis on z, centred on the origin; arguments are diameter, length, lead and number of starts (T8x8: 8, length, 8, 4). The thumbnail's plain-cylinder look is the library's default: NopSCADlib draws threads only when show_threads is on.

options.center: false puts the bottom end on z = 0

checks.source: T8 lead screw (Tr8x8, 4 starts): OD 8; z is the 100 mm length argument
